name: Deep Dark Pit
desc1: This huge, circular pit is at least twenty feet deep, with steep,
desc2: rough walls of stone. The ground is littered with cracked bones of
desc3: all shapes and sizes, along with the odd ruined piece of metal. A
desc4: horrible stench fills the pit, as if some mammoth, smelly beast lived
desc5: here. A small tunnel at the back of the pit leads into more darkness.
desc6: It may be possible to climb up the rough stone walls here.
